name: CLI-Anything
description: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: https://clianything.cc/
one_liner: A tool that automatically builds a command-line remote control for any piece of software, so an AI agent can operate it the way a person would click through a UI.
buyer: A developer-tools startup that wants its product usable by AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) without hand-building an integration.
business_use_cases: A SaaS vendor uses it to generate a CLI for their own product so customers' AI agents can automate tasks inside it, as a selling point.
An agency that builds internal tools for clients uses it to agent-enable legacy desktop software nobody wants to rewrite.
A marketplace (like the project's own CLI-Hub) charges software vendors to list a verified, agent-ready CLI for their product.

money_ideas.idea: Charge software vendors a fee to get their product's CLI verified and featured on the CLI-Hub marketplace.
Offer paid custom-CLI-generation services for companies with complex proprietary software.

steal_this: Pick one popular but agent-unfriendly desktop app, generate a clean CLI for it this weekend, and publish it to the hub to claim the 'first mover' listing.
